problem: A recovery attempt can itself become stale without a defined second-stage escalation path, leaving a dependency gate permanently blocked even after first-stage recovery exists.
acceptance: Detect a stale recovery attempt from append-only durable signals without reclassifying silence as failure.
Allow a collision-safe later recovery generation without overwriting the original claim or earlier recovery attempts.
Preserve and reconcile late returns from the original attempt and every recovery generation.
Prove on the Page Thread Bridge gate or an equivalent canary that one vanished recovery worker cannot permanently block downstream local integration.
title: Recursive Stale-Recovery Generation V1
mission: Define and implement stale-of-recovery escalation on top of the existing recovery-lineage ownership mechanism. Once a recovery generation has a single winner, that winner must emit durable liveness signals; if it itself crosses the recovery cutoff with no terminal RETURN, a later append-only generation may be atomically acquired with explicit previous-generation lineage. Do not duplicate the sibling recovery-lineage exclusivity proposal; consume it as the ownership primitive. Preserve original/late-return reconciliation and prove the chain on Page Thread Bridge or an isolated equivalent.

unblock_value.reason: Page Thread Bridge gates every local surface integration; a vanished first recovery worker must not become a permanent gate.

incident_repair.reason: The live Page Thread Bridge lineage already required recovery and then accumulated later recovery attempts, exposing the need for explicit recovery-generation semantics.

reuse_value.reason: A sibling candidate now owns same-generation exclusivity; this proposal is intentionally limited to N -> N+1 stale escalation and reconciliation.

must_fail_if: a new generation starts before the prior recovery generation satisfies stale/retry-safe evidence
generation N+1 overwrites or deletes original or generation N evidence
late original or recovery RETURN is discarded instead of reconciled
the implementation creates another same-generation ownership authority instead of consuming the sibling exclusivity primitive
proof_required: stale-of-recovery fixture proving N+1 activates only after durable cutoff
late-return reconciliation fixture across original plus at least two recovery generations
Page Thread Bridge-equivalent canary showing a vanished recovery worker cannot permanently hold the gate

acceptance_details: each recovery generation has explicit previous-generation lineage
generation N+1 cannot become write-authorized until generation N is recovery-eligible by durable evidence
same-generation exclusivity is delegated to the sibling recovery-lineage pin mechanism
all earlier evidence remains immutable and reconcilable
no Current/Human Accepted/Served authority is implied
